what_it_measures: Preservation of exact preregistered high-support position/disposition configurations
formula_or_exact_procedure: For frozen query set Q_high: weighted mean of indicator that representation can reconstruct exact configuration membership/support within stated tolerance; exact atlas target=1.0; geometry uses decoder/projection membership reconstruction
direction_or_threshold: Atlas exact floor must equal 1.0; geometry primary-role candidate >=.95

what_it_measures: Preservation of observed low-prevalence/low-support but lawful branches
formula_or_exact_procedure: Recall over frozen minority branch manifest; a branch counts preserved when existence, exact support tier, and its conditional alternatives remain recoverable without being merged into majority
direction_or_threshold: Atlas exact floor=1.0; geometry primary-role candidate >=.90; lower scores are explicit information loss

what_it_measures: Accuracy reconstructing held-out disposition distributions conditional on frozen position queries
formula_or_exact_procedure: For each query q, TV(p_obs,p_hat)=0.5*sum_j abs(p_j-p_hat_j); report support-weighted median, p90, and query-level vector; never only aggregate
direction_or_threshold: Lower better; material loss tolerance for decision comparison: median TV difference >.02 is material; no universal truth threshold

what_it_measures: Predictive information for exact held-out disposition targets
formula_or_exact_procedure: Negative log probability of observed held-out category/complex under frozen representation-specific decoder; report per-target and macro average with paired bootstrap delta
direction_or_threshold: Lower better; material gain = >=10% relative reduction and paired 95% descriptive bootstrap interval for delta excludes 0

what_it_measures: Preservation of lawfully coexposed higher-order respondent structure
formula_or_exact_procedure: Compare frozen order>=3 joint distributions/multi-information and motif membership; report JS/TV error plus recall of design-admitted motifs on holdout
direction_or_threshold: Lower distribution error/higher recall better; geometry primary-role candidate motif/J recall >=.90 on frozen high-support set

what_it_measures: Whether minority/contradictory disposition alternatives inside common position configurations survive compression
formula_or_exact_procedure: For each frozen high-support position query, compute recall and probability-mass error for nonmodal disposition outcomes above preregistered minimum empirical mass
direction_or_threshold: Primary representation cannot lose >.02 absolute mass on median query or omit >10% of frozen counterpatterns

what_it_measures: Sensitivity to lawful nuisance/method perturbations
formula_or_exact_procedure: Geometry: largest principal angle, pairwise-distance Spearman, retained-d delta; Atlas: query-answer TV, compact-object selection Jaccard, exact-fact hash invariance
direction_or_threshold: Report component metrics; geometry robust screen angle<=15deg, rho>=.90, delta_d<=1; atlas exact unaffected facts hash-identical

what_it_measures: Sampling sensitivity of learned compact structure
formula_or_exact_procedure: 200 design-set bootstrap resamples: geometry records fraction meeting subspace/neighborhood relation criterion; atlas records selection frequency/Jaccard for motifs/configuration relations
direction_or_threshold: Stable learned claim requires >=.80 bootstrap survival; exact raw facts exempt from learned-claim threshold

what_it_measures: Leverage of one rare semantic state
formula_or_exact_procedure: Compare outputs under all semantically lawful active/passive/reweight variants; report geometry influence and atlas compact-selection change while checking raw-fact preservation
direction_or_threshold: No master threshold beyond M07; any atlas raw rare fact loss is fail; geometry instability is typed method sensitivity

what_it_measures: Whether geometric local neighborhoods are stable under nuisance changes
formula_or_exact_procedure: k=max(10,min(50,round(sqrt(N_design)))); Jaccard of kNN sets respondent-wise; report median and p10 across perturbations
direction_or_threshold: Robust geometry: median>=.85 and p10>=.70

what_it_measures: Stability of pairwise order/distance-like relational ordering
formula_or_exact_procedure: Geometry: Spearman of pairwise distances/barycentric ranking; Atlas only for explicit probability/risk order in same frozen query family, never create distance
direction_or_threshold: Geometry robust screen rho>=.90; atlas report N/A where no lawful rank exists

what_it_measures: Whether learned relation exceeds topology/marginal-preserving nulls
formula_or_exact_procedure: >=999 seeded permutations. Record empirical percentile of observed dependence/downstream metric vs respondent-link null and higher-order structure vs within-item J null
direction_or_threshold: Strong cross-space relation-value claim >99th percentile; ordinary higher-order motif admission >95th percentile; otherwise NULL_NOT_DISTINCT

what_it_measures: Whether routed/nonexposed respondents can create apparent structure
formula_or_exact_procedure: Run FFP006 poison fixture; compare lawful outputs to clean build after exact risk-set enforcement
direction_or_threshold: Substantive outputs must be invariant within deterministic/floating tolerance. Any material change => hard invalidation

what_it_measures: Independence of position and disposition construction
formula_or_exact_procedure: Recursively expand exact source ancestry; count direct and derived measurement overlaps among active inputs; run injected ancestry trap
direction_or_threshold: Required count=0 and trap detection=PASS

what_it_measures: Storage and execution burden
formula_or_exact_procedure: Measure serialized bytes, atomic scalar count, object/row count, build CPU/time where available, median/p95 frozen-query latency; report hardware/runtime context
direction_or_threshold: Lower conditional on preservation; no standalone winner threshold

what_it_measures: Information preserved per representation size
formula_or_exact_procedure: For nested allowed compression levels, plot/report bytes or scalars versus M03/M05/M06 error; record minimum size achieving median query TV<=.05 if attainable
direction_or_threshold: A >=4x smaller representation at same <=.05 TV and no minority/J gate failure is material compression gain

what_it_measures: Marginal value to PRE-V3 possibility-packet consumer
formula_or_exact_procedure: Compare frozen decoder arms RAW, ATLAS, GEOMETRY, ATLAS+GEOMETRY on M03/M04 plus packet size. Geometry incremental value = ATLAS+GEOM vs ATLAS; atlas incremental = combined vs GEOM
direction_or_threshold: Material information gain = >=10% relative heldout log-loss improvement with paired 95% descriptive bootstrap interval excluding 0, OR >=4x compression at equivalent fidelity without preservation-gate loss

what_it_measures: Can exact output be reconstructed/revised/invalidated from governed inputs
formula_or_exact_procedure: Re-run same manifests/seeds/version; compare content hashes and declared numeric tolerance; verify every compact object has ancestry/risk-set/estimand backrefs
direction_or_threshold: All deterministic artifacts hash-identical; numeric decompositions within declared tolerance; missing provenance=FAIL

what_it_measures: Whether representation overstates evidence beyond support/design authority
formula_or_exact_procedure: Audit raw n, weighted n_eff, design authority, resampling labels, abstention states, and whether low-support claims are typed
direction_or_threshold: Zero unauthorized inferential claims; all low-support/generalization abstentions preserved

what_it_measures: Response to duplicate representation with zero new information
formula_or_exact_procedure: Run FFP001 clone. Atlas: substantive payload/query hash after ancestry dedup. Geometry: G1 numeric invariance plus G0 stability diagnostics
direction_or_threshold: Atlas hash invariant. G1 block-balanced output invariant within numeric tolerance. Claimed G0 robust structure must satisfy M07/M10 thresholds
